judgments.reason: The span 'apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest accompanied by hepatic dullness that was located in the left subcostal region' appears literally in the physical examination section of the vignette and clinically supports situs inversus totalis, as rightward cardiac apex combined with left-sided hepatic dullness indicates mirror-image reversal of thoracic and abdominal organs.

The span 'right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right' appears literally in the echocardiogram description and directly supports dextrocardia with situs inversus totalis by demonstrating mirror-image cardiac positioning.
